subject.title: fix(imessage): repair DM sender fallback before pairing

question: Should iMessage drop non-group, not-from-me direct payloads when sender still canonicalizes to destination_caller_id and a different peer cannot be confidently repaired before access control?
rationale: That choice decides whether this identity-boundary repair is only best-effort or fail-closed before authorization, pairing, session routing, and replies.

options.title: Repair Canonically And Drop Unrepairable Payloads
options.body: Require normalizeIMessageHandle comparisons, add regression coverage, and drop the narrow local-sender race when no confident peer is available.

options.title: Repair Only When A Peer Is Present
options.body: Merge only the canonical repair path and keep non-repairable payload handling unchanged, accepting that local-sender race ambiguity remains.

options.title: Pause For A Narrower Follow-Up
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the author's remaining failure is separated from this race and a scoped iMessage identity issue is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Repair Canonically And Drop Unrepairable Payloads
recommendation.body: Require normalizeIMessageHandle comparisons, add regression coverage, and drop the narrow local-sender race when no confident peer is available.
